attributes.name: character_backstory
attributes.current: I am the youngest daughter of the beloved ruler of the rich and fertile lands of the south known as Ellwe. Being the youngest and the only daughter, I was always overshadowed by my brothers. Forced to live up to the expectations I could never meet, I spent my childhood fighting a lost battle against my brothers and father. When I was 18, my brothers and I were on a hunting expedition when we were attacked by a magical being. None of my 5 brothers survived. I however, was left unscathed except for a tiny scar on my forehead, courtesy of a dark blur that rendered me unconscious. When I woke up, I was being hailed as a hero, the one who "survived". The story of my bravery and skill spread through the land as wildfire, but only I knew the truth. As the only heir my father quickly named me the scion of our house and I had everything that I ever dreamt of as a child. But, I didn't want it this way. I knew I will never deserve it and whatever killed my brothers took that chance from me. Ever since then, I am on a quest to prove my true worth to the entire world and bring justice to my brothers. I hope this train takes me to distant lands which offer some long due answers.
